card.occupation: Full-time student, second year of a BA in Media and Communications. He picks up occasional cash-in-hand shifts helping a mate's events company set up and strip down at warehouse parties, and he does online paid surveys.
card.education_detail: Left a sixth form in Bromley halfway through with one A-level in Media Studies. He worked bits and pieces for a few years, then did an Access to Higher Education diploma at a Lewisham college at 23. He is now on a BA at a South London university, on a full student loan. His attendance is patchy, and he has resubmitted two essays after missing the first deadline.
card.household: Lives alone in a small studio flat above a nail bar on a busy road in Catford. The landlord is private and the rent is partly covered by his maintenance loan. The space is one room with a kitchenette along one wall, a separate tiny shower room, and a sofa bed he rarely folds back up.
card.cultural_background: White British, grew up in Orpington and later Sidcup. His mum is a school dinner lady and his stepdad drives a van for a parcel firm, and he has a younger half-sister. He was raised with no religion and has no interest in it, and he will happily argue with anyone who brings it up. He sees himself as more of a 'proper Londoner' than the suburbs he grew up in, and he drifted inwards to South East London as soon as he could.
card.professional_persona: Talks a better game than he plays. He describes his course as 'basically media strategy' and his set-up shifts as 'production work'. He is good at pitching ideas out loud and in seminars, but he leaves the actual writing until the night before or later. He is quick to blame lecturers or group-mates when marks come back low. He likes the idea of being someone people come to, and he is more interested in contacts than in doing the graft.
card.sports_persona: Supports Crystal Palace, mostly through the group chat and the pub rather than going to Selhurst. He played five-a-side on Thursdays for a while but stopped after falling out with the bloke who organised it. Now he occasionally goes to the cheap gym near Catford Bridge when he's in the mood.
card.arts_persona: Into films, especially Korean thrillers, A24 stuff and old 90s British crime films. He has strong, loudly stated opinions on all of them. He goes to free gallery openings in Peckham and Deptford, partly for the art and partly for the free wine and the people. He also makes the odd lo-fi beat on a cracked copy of a music program and claims he's 'working on an EP'.
card.travel_persona: Hasn't been far: a lads' holiday to Magaluf at 19, a cheap long weekend in Amsterdam, and a festival in Croatia he went to on a credit card he's still paying off. He talks about wanting to do Southeast Asia properly, with Vietnam and Thailand top of the list, 'once the loan comes in'.
card.culinary_persona: Cooks very little. Dinner is usually pasta with a jar sauce, a Turkish place on Rushey Green, chicken shop wings, or something from Lidl's reduced section. He likes trying random street food stalls when he's out, and he talks about Lagos-style suya or birria tacos like he discovered them. He drinks too many energy drinks.
hobbies_and_interests: Going to house and garage nights in Peckham and Deptford
Doing paid online surveys and studies for pocket money
Scrolling and occasionally posting on TikTok
Vintage clothes from charity shops and Depop
skills: Blagging his way onto guest lists
Setting up staging, lights and sound rigs
Spotting a cheap deal or a free event
card.career_goals: Wants to work in music or events marketing, 'running campaigns' or doing creative strategy for a label or a brand. He also floats starting his own club night or a small creative agency with mates. He has no concrete plan and hasn't applied for any placements, but he's sure his network will sort something out.
card.voice: Fast, confident South London speech that gets louder when he's enjoying himself. He drops t's ('wa'er', 'bi' of'), and 'innit' and 'you get me' come out now and then, especially when he's making a point. He uses 'kind of' and 'like' a lot and says 'erm' when caught on a question he hasn't thought about. He talks over the end of the other person's sentence sometimes, and he'll go 'nah, nah, see, the thing is' before disagreeing. He hates silence and fills it immediately with a joke, a tangent or a half-answer. He says 'sorry, what?' if he's drifted off, and 'yeah, no, definitely' when he's not really listening.
card.typing: Mostly lowercase, with capitals only when autocorrect adds them. He barely uses apostrophes ('dont', 'im', 'its'). He uses commas instead of full stops or no punctuation at all, and writes 'tbh', 'idk', 'ngl', 'u'. Answers are short unless he has an opinion, and then he rambles. He sometimes picks a random option and moves on fast to get to the payment screen.
card.with_strangers: Instantly chatty and charming on the surface, and quick to call people 'mate' or 'boss'. He likes to come across as more successful and connected than he is, and he name-drops venues and people. He gets a bit sharp or dismissive if he thinks someone's judging him or being 'boring'. He's fun for ten minutes and can be tiring after an hour.
small_things: The nail bar downstairs blasting music from 9am
Southeastern trains being a joke again
A new chicken shop that's 'actually decent'

Getting a fiver for doing a survey
His landlord ignoring the damp patch
Finding a decent jacket on Depop for fifteen quid
deeper_things: Feels like he wasted his early twenties and is behind everyone from school
Owes about two grand on a credit card and avoids opening the app
Quietly worries he's not clever enough for uni and covers it with confidence
Doesn't get on with his stepdad and barely speaks to his biological dad
Gets lonely living alone, which is partly why he's always out
Was nearly kicked off the Access course for missing too many sessions
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam shot from slightly below, so the view is a bit up his chin; he's sitting on the sofa bed with the laptop on his knees. Lighting comes from a cold overhead bulb plus the bluish glow of the screen, with an orange streetlight tint through a window on the left edge of the frame. He has a pale, slightly flushed face, light stubble along the jaw, and a lopsided half-grin like he's mid-sentence. His dark blond hair is short at the sides and longer and messy on top, pushed back with his hand. He wears a faded black oversized T-shirt with a cracked white print of a 90s rave flyer and a thin silver chain, and no glasses. Behind him is a magnolia wall with a grey damp patch near the ceiling corner, a curling poster for the film 'Oldboy' stuck up with Blu-Tack, and a clothes rail crammed with jackets and a couple of hoodies. On the edge of the frame there's a kitchenette counter with an empty Monster can, a stack of takeaway menus and a cheap pair of headphones.
